study: DRST-PR Dual-Reference SpectroTemporal Patient-Relative seed42 v1

reference.interpretation: exploratory development, not fresh sealed confirmation

cohort.patient_set_inference: transductive zero-shot: unlabeled channels of the same target patient may be used

raw_amplitude.choice_from_label_free_stage0_audit: fixed robust scale for each patient-seizure-channel over its 60 s raw waveform's valid interval

spectral.global_fit_only_normalization: per-frequency mean/std over outer-fold FIT patients, no target contribution
spectral.self_pre_onset_reference: median of same patient/seizure/channel windows whose relative center <= -5 s, min 3 windows
spectral.patient_reference: median over all valid channels for same patient/seizure/window/frequency/local-time, label-free
spectral.frequency_band_boundary_rule: left inclusive, right exclusive except 100 Hz included in final band

architecture.tokenizer: shared MLP 3F or ablated-view F -> 128 GELU LayerNorm -> 64 GELU
architecture.cross_seizure: A1 CrossSeizureMILAggregator model_dim 64, masked mean+std output 128, fixed learned 128->64 projection
architecture.patient_context: one 2-head permutation-equivariant self-attention layer, no channel positional index

training.objective: exact A1 patient-equal weighted BCE, EZ:NEZ 2:1
training.fit_train_meta_partition: deterministic SHA256 sort by 42|fold|patient; 80% train, 20% meta, disjoint patient IDs
training.selection: FIT-meta patient-equal EZ-AP, epoch and hyperparameters FIT-only; ties: lower LR then larger WD then earlier epoch
training.raw_spectral_precompute: deterministic log-power cache allowed only as runtime acceleration; no learned state or labels
training.optional_SSL: not run in primary seed42 study

fusion.global_scaling: each input margin standardized by FIT-meta unlabeled mean/std from source-only predictions; never target-fitted
fusion.beta_selection: FIT-meta patient-equal EZ-AP; tie choose smaller beta; same rule for F1 and F0
fusion.A1_meta_scores: source-only A1 refit trained on FIT-train, with epoch FIT-meta selected; historical A1 VLOO scores retained for target fallback beta=0
fusion.A1_replicate: independent deterministic seed 43, same A1 architecture/objective/FIT split and selection

predeclared_limitations: Original A1 target reference was historically VLOO-selected using labels of other validation patients, whereas new S1-S4 models use strictly FIT-only selection; comparisons have a checkpoint-selection asymmetry.
Historical target outcomes were already viewed in prior branches, so this development study is exploratory even if new spectral models are prospectively locked.
Raw cache lacks explicit independently verified onset-centered and physical-unit/reference metadata.
The fourth raw-cache site is labeled pediatric; its identity as Fudan is not verified by cache metadata.
